title: Microsoft overhauls Azure compensation model: Who gets extra stock and who faces scrutiny? Here's what changes
summary: Microsoft is revising compensation in its Azure division to give top performers more stock awards and require formal discussions with employees falling short. The move reflects a broader push across the tech industry to improve productivity, amid Microsoft job cuts and voluntary buyouts.
llm_summary: Microsoft is revamping how it rewards Azure staff, giving high‑performing engineers larger stock grants while mandating formal performance‑review meetings for those who fall short. The change is part of a wider industry push to boost productivity as Microsoft trims headcount and offers voluntary buyouts.
